pairs.target: dìsìshíqī tiān , tǎ wéi zài dēngjìchù xiěxià zìjǐ de míngzì .
pairs.english: On day forty-seven, Tavi signed his name at the registry.
pairs.hanzi: 第四十七天，塔维在登记处写下自己的名字。

pairs.target: tā qiányìtiān xiàwǔ huídào bái jiē , xiān bǎ suāncài hé zhǎolíng jiāogěi pà wò , zài qù bào dào .
pairs.english: He had returned to White Steps the previous afternoon, delivered Pavo's pickles and change, then reported in.
pairs.hanzi: 他前一天下午回到白阶，先把酸菜和找零交给帕沃，再去报到。

pairs.target: nà táng luòxià de cèliáng kè ānpái zài míngzǎo . rújīn zhǐ shàng gāi wèn de yǐjīng wèn guò , tā bǎ zuìhòu yìbǐ xiě wán , kànzhe dēngjì de rén jiāng zìjǐ de fùběn zhé hǎo dì lái , méiyǒu zài bǎshǒu suōhuíqù .
pairs.english: His missed measurement lesson was set for tomorrow morning. Now all his questions had been asked; he finished the last stroke and accepted his folded copy without drawing his hand back.
pairs.hanzi: 那堂落下的测量课安排在明早。如今纸上该问的已经问过，他把最后一笔写完，看着登记的人将自己的副本折好递来，没有再把手缩回去。

pairs.target: chūménshí , yīwén zhèng kào zài lángzhù shàng , shǒulǐ bào zhe liǎngjuàn dìtú . " bāndōngxī ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: Outside, Iven leaned against a corridor pillar holding two rolled maps. “Moving things?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi:
出门时，伊文正靠在廊柱上，手里抱着两卷地图。
“搬东西？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " shàngkè . nǐ jīntiānxiàwǔ méi kè , gēn bu gēnwǒlái ? " tǎ wéi yǐwéi shì bāngmáng , shēnshǒu jiē le yíjuàn .
pairs.english: “Class. You're free this afternoon. Coming?” Tavi thought he wanted help and took a roll.
pairs.hanzi:
“上课。你今天下午没课，跟不跟我来？”
塔维以为是帮忙，伸手接了一卷。

pairs.target: yīwén yě méi lán , zhī shuō qiānwànbié nòngfǎn , lǎoshī ná cuò tú huì jiǎng dé hěn gāoxìng , dǐxià de rén yào dào xià bàn táng cái fāxiàn .
pairs.english: Iven let him, only warning against mixing them up: given the wrong map, the teacher would happily lecture until the students noticed halfway through.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文也没拦，只说千万别弄反，老师拿错图会讲得很高兴，底下的人要到下半堂才发现。

pairs.target: tú shì de dìbǎn shàng yǐjīng bǎimǎn mùpiàn . yǒu de diéchéng gāopō , yǒu de zhī pù yìcéng , zhōngjiān yòng lán shéng rào chū hédào .
pairs.english: Wooden pieces covered the map-room floor, some stacked as hills, others one layer deep, with blue string winding between as rivers.
pairs.hanzi: 图室的地板上已经摆满木片。有的叠成高坡，有的只铺一层，中间用蓝绳绕出河道。

pairs.target: shíláigè xuéshēng wéizhe tā zuò , xié dōu liúzài ménbiān . tǎ wéi tuōxié shí fāxiàn wà jiān báo le , gǎnjǐn bǎ jiǎo wǎng dèngzǐ dǐxià shōu .
pairs.english: A dozen students sat around it, shoes left at the door. Taking his off, Tavi noticed his sock toes thinning and tucked his feet under his stool.
pairs.hanzi: 十来个学生围着它坐，鞋都留在门边。塔维脱鞋时发现袜尖薄了，赶紧把脚往凳子底下收。

pairs.target: dài kè de lǎoxiānshēng jiēguò dìtú , gěi měirén fā le yìxiǎo duàn hóng shéng , shuō zhè shì yíduì sòngliáng de rén . yào cóng xībiān sòngdào dōngbiān , xiān zìjǐ zhǎo lù .
pairs.english: The elderly teacher took the maps and gave everyone a short red string: a grain convoy. Find a route from west to east themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 带课的老先生接过地图，给每人发了一小段红绳，说这是一队送粮的人。要从西边送到东边，先自己找路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xuǎn le zuì duǎn de shānjǐ . mùpiàn biānyuán píngzhěng , shéng yì dā guòqù , xiàng yǒu yìtiáo xiànchéng de dào .
pairs.english: Tavi chose the shortest ridge. The wood edges were smooth; draped across them, the string looked like a ready-made road.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维选了最短的山脊。木片边缘平整，绳一搭过去，像有一条现成的道。

pairs.target: tā gāng fàng hǎo , xiānshēng biàn bǎ zhōngjiān liǎngpiàn fēnkāi yìdiǎn . " zhè yíduàn méi rén xiū le . " " rào xiàqù ? "
pairs.english: As soon as he placed it, the teacher separated two middle pieces a little. “No one maintains this stretch anymore.” “Go around below?”
pairs.hanzi:
他刚放好，先生便把中间两片分开一点。
“这一段没人修了。”
“绕下去？”

pairs.target: xiānshēng méi dá , jiào tā kàn lìng yìzhāng tú . nà zhāng zhǐ de hébiān yǒu lù , shānjǐ fǎnér liúbái .
pairs.english: Without answering, the teacher directed him to another map. There was a road beside the river on that sheet; the ridge was blank.
pairs.hanzi:
先生没答，叫他看另一张图。
那张纸的河边有路，山脊反而留白。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi shì gèng zǎo de huàfǎ , yīwén zhǐzhe jiǎo shàng de nián , gàosù tā zhè shì xīn de , gāngcái nàfú cái jiù le èrshíduōnián .
pairs.english: Tavi thought it was an older map. Iven pointed to the year in the corner: this was new; the first was over twenty years old.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为是更早的画法，伊文指着角上的年，告诉他这是新的，刚才那幅才旧了二十多年。

pairs.target: jǐgè rén de hóng shéng dōu dé zhòng bǎi . yígè xuéshēng bùkěn bǎ shéng fàng dī , shuō dī dì bù ānquán .
pairs.english: Several students had to reposition their strings. One refused to lower his, saying the lowlands were unsafe.
pairs.hanzi: 几个人的红绳都得重摆。一个学生不肯把绳放低，说低地不安全。

pairs.target: xiānshēng jiāng yíkuài huīsè mùpiàn yā zài hébiān , jiào tā xiān shuō nǎ yìzhǒng bù ānquán : shuǐ zhǎng , luòshí , háishì jiùshū lǐ xiě de nàxiē shì .
pairs.english: The teacher set a grey block beside the river and asked what kind of danger: flooding, rockfall or the things in old books?
pairs.hanzi: 先生将一块灰色木片压在河边，叫他先说哪一种不安全：水涨、落石，还是旧书里写的那些事。

pairs.target: xuéshēng búzuòshēng le . tǎ wéi yě zài kàn nà kuài mùpiàn .
pairs.english: The student fell silent. Tavi watched the grey block too.
pairs.hanzi: 学生不作声了。塔维也在看那块木片。

pairs.target: xiānshēng ràng yīwén niàn yìxiǎo duàn jiù jì . nà búshì yīngyǒng táonàn de gē , zhī jì le sāntiān lǐ cāng mén de tiě shuān wānxiàqù , bèiyòng de jǐgēn yě chēngbúzhù ;
pairs.english: The teacher asked Iven to read a short old account. No heroic flight in song: three days in which warehouse iron bolts bent and even the spare bars failed.
pairs.hanzi: 先生让伊文念一小段旧记。那不是英勇逃难的歌，只记了三天里仓门的铁闩弯下去，备用的几根也撑不住；

pairs.target: chénglǐrén bǎ liáng bān dào gāochù , huílái fāxiàn yǒuxiē jiē shénme dōu méi biàn , gé yídào gōu què lián diào chèng dōu bùnéng yòng le .
pairs.english: Townspeople moved grain uphill, then returned to find some streets unchanged, while across a ditch even hanging scales no longer worked.
pairs.hanzi: 城里人把粮搬到高处，回来发现有些街什么都没变，隔一道沟却连吊秤都不能用了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ liànxí shí liǎngpiàn gāngtiáo zhījiān nà yìdiǎn biànhuà , bèishàng hūrán yǒuxiē liáng .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the slight change between his practice strips and felt a chill along his back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起练习时两片钢条之间那一点变化，背上忽然有些凉。

pairs.target: tā kàn xiàng yīwén , yīwén méiyǒu tái yǎn , jiēzhe niàn rénmen zěnyàng zài yǔ lǐ páiduì děng liáng , zuìhòu yìháng shuō shī le zhàng , shùmù bù quán .
pairs.english: He looked at Iven, who kept reading without looking up: people queued for grain in the rain. The last line said records had been lost; the count was incomplete.
pairs.hanzi: 他看向伊文，伊文没有抬眼，接着念人们怎样在雨里排队等粮，最后一行说失了账，数目不全。

pairs.target: " shuí zuò de ? " yǒurén wèn . " bù zhīdào . zhè yíyè méi xiě , biéde jìzǎi yǒu biéde shuōfǎ . jīntiān bù xuǎn yígè tīng zhe zuì xiàng dáàn de . "
pairs.english: “Who did it?” someone asked. “Unknown. This page doesn't say; other accounts differ. Today we won't choose whichever sounds most like an answer.”
pairs.hanzi:
“谁做的？”有人问。
“不知道。这一页没写，别的记载有别的说法。今天不选一个听着最像答案的。”

pairs.target: xiānshēng názǒu gāopō shàng jǐkuài báo mùpiàn , lùchū xiàmiàn yìzhěngkuài hòu mùbǎn .
pairs.english: The teacher removed several thin pieces from the hill, revealing one thick board beneath.
pairs.hanzi: 先生拿走高坡上几块薄木片，露出下面一整块厚木板。

pairs.target: zǎoqī bìnàn de rén cháng zài zhèzhǒng zhěngkuài yán dìshàng liúxià . bìng búshì yuè gāo yuè búhuì chūshì , yǒuxiē gāo dìfāng hòulái yě bānzǒu le .
pairs.english: Early refugees often settled on whole beds of rock like this. Greater height was no guarantee; some high settlements were abandoned later too.
pairs.hanzi: 早期避难的人常在这种整块岩地上留下。并不是越高越不会出事，有些高地方后来也搬走了。

pairs.target: hébiān nà kuài huīsè mùpiàn dàibiǎo yíchù dī dì yán tái , lù cóng nàlǐ ràoguò , duō zǒu yírì , què yǐjīng yòng le hěnduōnián .
pairs.english: The grey piece by the river represented a lowland rock terrace. A road detoured across it, adding a day but already used for many years.
pairs.hanzi: 河边那块灰色木片代表一处低地岩台，路从那里绕过，多走一日，却已经用了很多年。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ hóng shéng yìdiǎndiǎn wǎng hébiān yí . tā yǐqián yǐwéi shān wài shì tóng yípiàn bùnéng zhù de dìfāng , lǐmiàn língxīng cáng zhe yuèjiè kè cái zhǎo dédào de hǎo dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi edged his red string toward the river. He had thought everything outside the mountains was equally uninhabitable, hiding a few treasures only Outriders could find.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把红绳一点点往河边移。他以前以为山外是同一片不能住的地方，里面零星藏着越界客才找得到的好东西。

pairs.target: kě ruò sòngliáng de rén měinián dōu zǒu , yǒurén zhǒng , yǒurén shōu , nàlǐ jiù dé yǒu děng zhe liáng lái de rén .
pairs.english: But if grain convoys came every year, if someone planted and someone harvested, there must be people waiting for grain.
pairs.hanzi: 可若送粮的人每年都走，有人种，有人收，那里就得有等着粮来的人。

pairs.target: " nà wèishénme tú shàng bù dōu huà chūlái ? " tā wèn . xiānshēng fǎnwèn tā , zhè zhāng tú shì shuí chūqián huà de .
pairs.english: “Why aren't they all on the map?” he asked. The teacher asked who had paid for this map.
pairs.hanzi:
“那为什么图上不都画出来？”他问。
先生反问他，这张图是谁出钱画的。

pairs.target: yīwén fān dào bèimiàn , zhǎodào yíchù huòzhàn de míngzì . xiānshēng ràng tā niàn de háiyǒu hòu bànjù : gòng běixiàn xún xiū shǐyòng .
pairs.english: Iven turned it over and found a freight station's name. The teacher also made him read the following words: for northern-route inspection and maintenance.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文翻到背面，找到一处货站的名字。先生让他念的还有后半句：供北线巡修使用。

pairs.target: túhuà dào gōngzuò yào qù de dìfāng biàn tíng le . méiyǒu huà chūlái de , bùquánshì méiyǒu lù ; huà le xiàn de , yě búshì yǒngyuǎn yǒurén tì nǐ xiū .
pairs.english: The map stopped where its work stopped. Unmapped places were not all roadless, and a drawn line did not mean someone would always maintain it.
pairs.hanzi: 图画到工作要去的地方便停了。没有画出来的，不全是没有路；画了线的，也不是永远有人替你修。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ bèimiàn de zì yòu kàn le yíbiàn , nábǐ chāoxià . tā shuō zìjǐ fùqīn sòng guò de xìn lǐ , yě yǒu zhèzhǒng zhī xiěgěi yílù rén de yuēdìng .
pairs.english: Iven reread and copied the words on the back. His father's correspondence had included agreements meant for only one route's people too, he said.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把背面的字又看了一遍，拿笔抄下。他说自己父亲送过的信里，也有这种只写给一路人的约定。

pairs.target: tā yǐqián dú nàxiē zì , zǒng juéde wúfēi shì chēnghu hé luòkuǎn .
pairs.english: He used to think those words were merely forms of address and signatures.
pairs.hanzi: 他以前读那些字，总觉得无非是称呼和落款。

pairs.target: " yǐhòu wǒ xiǎng kàn qiánmiàn nà jǐyè . " tā shuō , shēngyīn bú dà , bìng bú xiàng yào zài kètáng shàng dátí .
pairs.english: “I want to read the earlier pages next time,” he said quietly, not as though answering a classroom question.
pairs.hanzi: “以后我想看前面那几页。”他说，声音不大，并不像要在课堂上答题。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu shuō zìjǐ yě yíyàng . tā xiǎngdào de shì nàfú liàngzhe xiǎo kùzǐ de gōng fāng tú , xiǎng zhīdào tú wài de hédào , dōngtiān huì buhuì biànzhǎi .
pairs.english: Tavi did not say he felt the same. He thought of the workshop picture with small trousers drying, wondering if the river beyond its frame narrowed in winter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有说自己也一样。他想到的是那幅晾着小裤子的工坊图，想知道图外的河道，冬天会不会变窄。

pairs.target: sàn kè yǐhòu , liǎng rén bǎ shéngzi juàn hǎo . yīwén de hóng shéng zuìhòu rào dé hěn yuǎn , xiānshēng méi shuō tā duì , zhī jiào tā biéwàngjì yánlù bǔ liáng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: After class they rolled the strings up. Iven's final route was long. The teacher did not call it correct, only reminded him of food supplies along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 散课以后，两人把绳子卷好。伊文的红绳最后绕得很远，先生没说他对，只叫他别忘记沿路补粮的地方。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe zìjǐ de lùxiàn , liú dào zuìhòu cái qǐshēn . tǎ wéi zài láng wài děng tā , náchū xiěgěi wù wān de xìn .
pairs.english: He studied his route and was last to rise. Tavi waited outside with his letter to Mistbay.
pairs.hanzi:
他盯着自己的路线，留到最后才起身。
塔维在廊外等他，拿出写给雾湾的信。

pairs.target: chǐcùn hé quēkǒu dōu huà zài lǐmiàn , túcè niánfèn yě xiě le ; tā méi wèn zìjǐ de shēnshì , zhī wèn néng bunéng rènchū zhèjiàn jiùwù , gōng fāng shìfǒu hái zài lù chà .
pairs.english: Inside were the dimensions and notch drawing, plus the catalog year. He asked nothing about his origins: only whether they could identify the old piece and whether the workshop was still in Deerfork.
pairs.hanzi: 尺寸和缺口都画在里面，图册年份也写了；他没问自己的身世，只问能不能认出这件旧物，工坊是否还在鹿汊。

pairs.target: yīwén tì tā kàn le dìzhǐ , gǎizhèng yígè lòudiào de bǐhuà . liǎng rén qù běi gōng fāng , bǎ xìn jiāogěi fùzé zhuǎnjiāo shāngduì xìnjiàn de rén , wènqīng fèiyòng , liúxià bái jiē de huíxìn dìzhǐ .
pairs.english: Iven checked the address and corrected a missing stroke. They took it to the north workshop's caravan-letter forwarder, confirmed the fee and left White Steps as the reply address.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文替他看了地址，改正一个漏掉的笔画。两人去北工坊，把信交给负责转交商队信件的人，问清费用，留下白阶的回信地址。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén gàosù tā nǎyìtiān néng shōudào dáfù . xìn fàngjìn dài sòng de dàizǐ yǐhòu , tā de shǒu kōng le .
pairs.english: No one could give him a date for a reply. Once the letter was in the outgoing bag, his hands were empty.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人告诉他哪一天能收到答复。信放进待送的袋子以后，他的手空了。

pairs.target: tā hé yīwén zǒu huíqù shí , hái zài zhēnglùn nàduàn hóng shéng jiūjìng gāibugāi zài wǎng xià rào yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Walking back with Iven, he was still arguing whether the red string should detour a little lower.
pairs.hanzi: 他和伊文走回去时，还在争论那段红绳究竟该不该再往下绕一点。
